title: Procedure Pending Pre-Authorization
preview: This week: a deductible, a denial letter, and one very long itemized bill.

jokes.setup: My insurer says my high-deductible plan is designed to give me skin in the game.
jokes.punchline: Which is fair, since the surgery is the only way I'm getting any of it back out.

jokes.setup: The hospital proudly announced its new price transparency tool.
jokes.punchline: It's very transparent: you can clearly see the price is 'to be determined after the procedure.'

cartoon.caption: “The good news is the surgery is covered. The bad news is the anesthesia, the lighting, and the room are not.”
cartoon.alt: A nervous patient lies on an operating table as a surgeon with a calculator and clipboard stands beside a nurse holding an endless itemized bill.
